loose.reason: Here the React part leaves a second tab stop (tabindex 0) on the option that had focus when Shift+Tab closed the list earlier. It does so only after that Shift+Tab close followed by a letter typed while closed. A page keeps one tab stop, on the option that has focus.

steps.free: Not required. Here the React part opens the list on the option that had focus when Shift+Tab closed it earlier, not on the option picked since. It does so only after that Shift+Tab close followed by a letter typed while closed. A page opens it on the picked option.
